name: card
title: Card
description: A card for React and shadcn, with shadcn's parts and an optional link that makes the whole card clickable.

meta.details: A card with shadcn's parts and slots, so it swaps straight in. A static card holds still; with a CardLink the whole card lifts, presses and rings as one link, and autoHeight springs its height as content changes.

docs: Import Card, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription, CardAction, CardContent, CardFooter and CardLink from components/eased/card/card. Card props: size (default, sm), autoHeight. CardTitle and CardLink take render. The Eased tokens were merged into your global CSS; nothing to import.
